description: This file defines the LogView class, which extends TextView and implements LogNode. It is used for displaying log messages in a user interface element, formatting log data, handling concurrency with UI thread updates, and supporting chain-of-responsibility with the next LogNode.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that implements LogNode to display log messages with formatted output, supporting log chaining and UI thread updates.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for initializing LogView with different sets of context and attributes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats incoming log data and appends it to the LogView; handles thread-safe updates and propagates log messages if a chain exists.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings with delimiters if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Outputs a string as a new line in the LogView.
